hero.title: Enterprise-grade delivery, lean-team responsiveness.
hero.subtitle: Campanelli Analytics LTDA is a Brazilian data engineering, automation and BI company, headquartered in Muzambinho (Minas Gerais) and operating from Lisbon, Portugal.

story: The company grew out of its founder's work on data projects for government, public health and large enterprises in Europe, where reliability, security and auditability are non-negotiable.
We bring that standard to companies and public bodies in Europe and Brazil with a lean structure: the person who designs the solution is the person who builds it.

items.title: Measurable outcomes
items.text: Every project starts with a clear target in hours, cost or revenue.

items.title: Senior delivery
items.text: No layers: whoever designs the solution builds it.

items.title: Confidentiality
items.text: Client data and projects handled discreetly and under GDPR/LGPD.

items.title: Client autonomy
items.text: Documentation and knowledge transfer to your team.

founder.title: Founder & Technical Director
bio: Wallison Campanelli is a senior data engineer with projects delivered for government, public health, energy, oil & gas, water utilities, semiconductors, automotive and manufacturing across Brazil, Portugal, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
He works across the whole data lifecycle: process automation, databases, ETL/ELT pipelines, platforms on Microsoft Fabric and Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, PySpark, SQL and Power BI.

He has a background in Mining Engineering and Physics and is a PhD candidate in Physics at the University of Lisbon. That grounding gives him the analytical rigour and systems thinking he applies to business problems.
He works in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: This policy explains how Campanelli Analytics LTDA (Brazilian CNPJ 62.856.593/0001-40) handles information submitted voluntarily through this website, in line with the GDPR and Brazil's LGPD (Law 13.709/2018).

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text: Name, email, phone, organisation, location and the message sent through the contact form, used solely to respond to your request.

sections.heading: How data is sent
sections.text: The form is processed by the FormSubmit service, which forwards the message to our email. The website does not store submissions in its own database, and we do not sell or share them for marketing.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: You may request access to, correction of or deletion of your data at any time.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.text: By accessing this website, you agree to these terms of use.

sections.heading: Purpose of the site
sections.text: This website presents institutional and commercial information about Campanelli Analytics LTDA. It is not a binding offer; engagement terms are set out in specific proposals and contracts.

sections.heading: Case studies and experience
sections.text: The projects described were delivered by the company's technical leadership, directly or in partnership with consultancies. Client names are omitted for confidentiality.

sections.heading: No warranties
sections.text: Content is provided for information purposes. We make reasonable efforts to keep it accurate and up to date.
